decision: ADR-023 §4 (owner 2026-10-20, refusal rules v2 option B): the v1 rules and their order, with one narrow exception. The refuse entries listed in marketing_only (unsubscribe: 退订 / 取消订阅 / unsubscribe; sms-stop-keyword: a whole message TD or stop) stop only marketing (a marketing unsubscribe record, no contact restriction) when, and only when, the latest dispatched proactive message to that consumer was marketing and was admitted within window_days. Otherwise they restrict all contact as in v1. Every other refuse entry and every uncertain entry restricts all contact; a message that also hits any of them restricts all contact (a full-stop hit always wins). v1's unsubscribe entry is split: 拉黑 / 屏蔽你们 / 删除我的号码 move to block-or-erase, which always restricts. Deterministic, no model call; exclusions first as in v1. A customer who wants everything stopped says so again (for example 别联系我) and is restricted.

refuse.pattern: (不要|别|不用|勿|请勿|不必|甭)\s*(再|在|继续)?\s*(给我|跟我|向我|和我|对我|找我)?\s*(发|打|推送|推|联系|打扰|骚扰|找|call|text)
(拉黑|屏蔽你们|删除我的(号码|手机号|联系方式))
(再|继续)\s*(发|打|联系|骚扰|推送).{0,8}(投诉|报警|举报|起诉)

uncertain.pattern: (少|别老|别总|不要老|不要总|别一直|不要一直)\s*(给我)?\s*(发|打|联系|推)
(烦死了|很烦|太烦了|别烦我|不胜其烦)

exclusions.pattern: (发|寄)\s*(错|漏|顺丰|快递|货|过来|到)
